### Observed differences

- A01 disappears: it ran in about 40 of 200 traces before (20%, at late positions, mean relative position about 0.67) and in none of the 200 traces in the later window; its only observed outgoing edge, A01 → A04, is also unobserved afterwards. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- In the later window, four activities appear that were not observed before: A02 in about 95 of 200 traces (about 48%, roughly one occurrence per trace), A13 in about 95 (48%), A12 in about 51 (26%) and A09 in about 51 (26%); all sit in the first half of the trace (mean positions about 0.30–0.52). [OCC002, OCC005, OCC004, OCC003, POS002, POS004, POS005, POS006]
- Routing out of A03 changed: before, its outgoing transitions went to A08 (about 52%) or directly to A04 (about 46%); in the later window they go to A08 (about 52%) or to A02 (about 46%), with the direct edge to A04 nearly gone (about 1 in 100). [DIR003]
- The new block is wired as follows: A02 leads to A12 (about 54% of its outgoing) or A13 (about 45%); A12 leads back to A02 (about 99%); A13 leads to A04 (about 99%). A02 and A12 co-occur or interleave in about half of the traces, and A03 precedes A13 in about 47% of traces. [DIR002, DIR006, DIR007, REL012, REL017, REL013]
- A08's repetition is rerouted: before, about 43% of A08's outgoing transitions were self-repeats at a distance of one step; in the later window about 45% go to A09, which leads back to A08 in all observed cases, and the A08-to-A08 distance shifts from one step (about 29% of pairs) to two steps (about 36%). [DIR004, DIR005, LAG003, REL021]
- A14 is rewired: before, all of its observed outgoing transitions led to A01; in the later window all lead to A04, and the A14-to-A04 distance collapses from mostly two steps (about 43%) to adjacent (about 41% at one step). [DIR008, LAG004]
- A04 is present in every trace in both windows but runs later: mean relative position about 0.58 before versus about 0.71 after, with A03-to-A04 distances stretched towards three and five steps (about 39% each after). [POS003, LAG001]
- Relations flip: A01's co-occurrences with A03, A04 and A14 (about 20% of traces before) vanish, while new co-occurrences appear (A02–A13 about 48%, A03–A13 about 48%, A02–A12 about 26%). A09 and the A02/A12/A13 block behave largely as alternatives rather than together (A09–A13: no co-occurrence; A09-only about 26%, A13-only about 48%). [REL002, REL003, REL007, REL013, REL017, REL012, REL025, REL011]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility of a structural reorganisation of the process middle. In the later window, A01 is no longer observed and the chain it sat in (A14 → A01 → A04) is replaced by a direct A14 → A04 connection; at the same time, a new block (A02, A12, A13) runs between A03 and A04 in roughly half of the traces (A03 → A02, A02 → A12 or A13 with A12 feeding back to A02, A13 → A04), and A09 is inserted into the repetition of A08 (A08 → A09 → A08 instead of a direct A08 repeat). As a result, A04 is executed later in the trace. The change is shown directly rather than inferred: appearance and disappearance are measured on 0 versus about 95 or 51 of 200 traces, successor changes are observed for A03, A08, A14 and the new activities, and the relational, positional and distance items agree with one another; 54 items qualified in screening against roughly 0.36 expected by chance if nothing had changed. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS003, REL012, REL017]

Limitations: zero participation only means "not observed", so it cannot be fully excluded that A01 or the new activities existed before at rates too low to appear in 200 traces; the mixed A02/A12 ordering (both directions observed) leaves open whether the new block is a simple loop or parallel repeats; positions and distances are event positions, so no statement about clock-time timing is possible. [OCC001, REL012]

Other differences: A03's marginal outgoing edges to A05, A06 and A10 (about 0.5–1.5% of its transitions before) are no longer observed; A14 appears slightly later (mean position about 0.58 to 0.70) and in slightly fewer traces (about 40 versus 35 of 200); small distance redistributions appear for A04–A04, and the A14–A14 distance item rests on only 6 and 4 observations. [DIR003, POS007, LAG002, LAG005]
